welcomeDefault: Pay with Mobile Money to get online instantly
noPackages: No internet packages are available at this location yet. Check back soon or ask the staff.
payHint: Pay via Campay — your phone number becomes your WiFi username. A PIN appears here after payment; then tap Connect.
offline: Router offline — Mobile Money payments are unavailable until it reconnects.
degraded: Router connectivity is degraded — payments may be delayed.
fairUse: Fair use limit reached. Buy another package to continue.
waitingBody: Your WiFi username and PIN appear here instantly once Campay confirms payment.
comeBack: You can close this page and come back — we'll pick up where you left off.
saveCreds: Save your username and PIN below, then connect to WiFi when the router is ready.
family: Family plan — up to {{n}} devices can share this access code.
unlimitedTime: Unlimited data for this browse period
connectFailHint: If connect fails, wait a few seconds and tap again.
waitImport: Your credentials stay here. Wait for the router to import access, then connect.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Choose a package to renew.
loadSlow: Portal is taking too long to load. Retry or open in your browser.
stillWaiting: Still waiting for MoMo approval. Tap “Check payment status” if you already paid.
logoutFailed: Could not log out. Try again.
disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect this device. Try again.
cancelFailed: Could not cancel payment. Try again.
connectFromCaptive: Open this portal from the WiFi captive page so Connect is available, or enter these credentials on the hotspot login.
